card.name: Patient counts before percentages in trials
card.fires_on: The word or bracket right after a number of patients or subjects in clinical-trial results, most often the "(" that opens a percentage. It also fires on words like cases, patient, per and those after a count.

modes.label: Open bracket after count
modes.description: The "(" following a number of subjects, just before the percentage.
modes.example: Among the 355 patients who received ROZLYTREK across clinical trials, 51<< (>>14%) experienced sleep disturbances.

modes.label: Unit word after number
modes.description: A word such as cases, patient or per right after a number in a frequency statement.

card.writes: It pushes away words about counts and statistics, so the text is not steered toward the word count itself.
card.plain: It marks the spot right after a number of patients in a trial result, where the percentage usually comes next.
